map.连续复利在现实中存在吗？: Does continuous compounding exist in reality?
map.银行不会真按瞬时复利计息，但它是对「复利频率趋于无穷」的理论抽象，广泛用于连续时: Banks do not truly compound instantaneously, but it is the theoretical abstraction of infinite compounding frequency, widely used for discounting and growth in continuous-time finance models (e.g. Black-Scholes).
map.连续复利和普通复利公式怎么换算？: How do continuous and ordinary compounding formulas convert?
map.令 e^r = (1+i/n)^n 的极限。已知年化 r，任何普通复利频率都严格: Take the limit e^r = (1+i/n)^n. For a given annual r, any ordinary compounding frequency is strictly less than the continuous upper bound e^r−1.
